meta.description: Jekhane pharmit o phari konbhenoshne notunra notun bondhu banay. Global Furry Television-er poksh theke.
site.name: GFTV HelloSpot
official.line: Global Furry Television-er ekti ophisiyal oyebsait
official.domain-heading: GFTV-er ophisiyal saitgulo globalfurry.tv ba gftv.asia diye shesh hoy
official.domain-body: Thikanati shesh dik theke porun: Prothom ekok slyasher ager shesh dotti dekhun. Ony kichhu diye shesh hooya sait GFTV-er noy, thikanar ager onshe namti thakleo.
official.secure-body: Ekti talar chihn ba thikanar shurute https:// khunjun. Byoktigot tothy kebol nirapod sonyoge kono ophisiyal saitei din.
update.label: Apdet
update.ready: GFTV HelloSpot-er ekti notun sonskoron prostut.
hero.card-alt: HelloSpot nam kard. Ete ekti bor hasir pashe Hello o 哈喽 lekha, pechhne GFTV-er rondhnu dora.
hero.title: Apni ekti HelloSpot khunje peyechhen!
hero.lede: Pharmit o phari konbhenoshne HelloSpot holo sei jayga, jekhane notunra notun bondhu banay.
how.title: HelloSpot keebhabe kaj kore
how.spot.title: Hasita khunjun
how.spot.body: Kono kard, lyaniyard ba sainborde HelloSmile khunjun. Eti jekhanei thakuk, setii HelloSpot.
how.hello.title: Hyalo bolun
how.hello.body: Kachhe ese hai bolun. HelloSpot-e keu asha kore na je apni age thekei kauke chenen.
how.friend.title: Bondhu banan
how.friend.body: Ashepasher manusher songe porichit hon, ar porer mite khonjar moto ekjonke niye phirun.
gallery.title: HelloSpot-e gora bondhutb
takagi.when.title: Takagi kokhon?
takagi.when.body: Protiti mit ei proshn diyei shesh hoy.
takagi.now.title: Takagi ekhoni!!
takagi.now.body: Achchha, kokhon kokhon jijnes kora thamao.
takagi.eaten.title: Takagi khaoya shesh.
takagi.photo-1: Ekti trete ek bati ramen o alada nudlos, pashe ekti chhot Eevee putul
takagi.photo-2: Chopstik o duti chhot saladsoh Takagi Ramen-er ekti tekojaoye ordar
takagi.photo-3: Ekti trete ramen, alada nudlos, phrayed chiken o salad
takagi.photo-4: Ekti trete ek bati pork ramen, giyoja o aisod ti
takagi.photo-5: Chopstik, barti nudlos o aisod lemon ti-soh ek bati ramen
takagi.photo-6: Takagi Express dokaner samner onsh, kauntare lal tul
about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) Singapurbhittik, Eshiyar sobcheye bor phari phyandom sonbad chyanel.
about.body-2: Amra pharider bere otha tule dhori, jate aj o agameete sobai ta upbhog korte pare, ar emon jayga toiri kori jekhane manush eke oporke jante o bujhte pare.
about.body-3: Ghor theke prodhan mohadeshgulo jure bistrit GFTV-er dol antorjatik, bohusanskritik o bohubhashik.
outro.title: Porer HelloSpot-e dekha hobe!
